senses.gloss: Tsadé, name of the eighteenth letter of the alphabet.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:6">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> (symbolization of letters) <he>צ׳ כפופה צדיק וכ׳ …</he> Tsadé bent, Tsadé straitened, righteous when bent, righteous when straitened (v. <cite ref="K01043"><he>כָּפַף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:13">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> <he>צ׳ צ׳</he> the two forms of Ts.
<cite ref="Shevuot 35b:4">Shebu. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ בי״ת מצבאות</he> if one wrote Tsadé and Beth, intending to write <cite ref="R00021"><he>צבאות</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>צָדִין</he>.
